scope.title: Re-verify A4 decision-quality controlled pilot gate

decision.reason: A4 module-level scoring/counters and the documented A4-first degradation order pass at the original thresholds, but the Active Pilot production gate remains NO-GO: the development manual requires A4 to be offline/dev-tool-only, there is no production audit caller, and A4 is not part of the measured per-turn cumulative latency smoke. The archived pilot spec was not treated as current production promotion.

criterion2_auditCoverage.evidence: module-level auditBatch increments auditedDecisions by records.length; no production caller in openclaw_runtime/src; development manual requires A4 offline/dev-tool-only

criterion4_degradationOrder.threshold: A4 is first in degradation order A4->A3->A5->A1 and cumulative latency budget is respected
criterion4_degradationOrder.evidence: tests/unit/trace-truncation.test.ts proves a4/a3/a5 drop before a1; tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts does not include A4

specDriftFixed.issue: The archived A4 pilot spec's requiredTests listed only deprecation-counters and performance-budgets, omitting the real decision-quality auditor, A4 deep, and trace degradation-order tests.
specDriftFixed.fix: Added tests/unit/decision-quality-auditor.test.ts, tests/unit/deep/a4-deep.test.ts, tests/unit/trace-truncation.test.ts, and tests/unit/a04-a4-gate-coverage.test.ts; thresholds unchanged.

a4Evidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/decision-quality-auditor.test.ts tests/unit/deprecation-counters.test.ts tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts tests/unit/deep/a4-deep.test.ts tests/unit/trace-truncation.test.ts tests/unit/a04-a4-gate-coverage.test.ts

residual.productionCaller: No production A4 audit caller exists; the development manual explicitly says A4 is offline/dev-tool-only and must not run on any production turn path, so the Active Pilot production criterion remains NO-GO rather than being fabricated.
residual.cumulativeLatency: A4 is not included in the A5+A1+A3 cumulative latency smoke; that numeric production latency criterion is NOT-MEASURED.
residual.pilotOnly: A4 remains offline/controlled pilot; no default-on/GA, no product lock change.
residual.scope: Deterministic unit evidence; no live provider/real-human.

independentVerification.detail: Each A4 criterion was mapped to a current assertion or explicitly recorded NO-GO/NOT-MEASURED; the guard pins requiredTests, the degrade action, A4-first drop order, and the offline-only production boundary. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.
